guide.effects_common_vars_guideline: Prioritize using defined tokens such as var(--transition-base) or var(--easing-spring). This ensures visual consistency and motion quality across the entire library.
guide.effects_desc: Definitions for elevation (shadows) and motion (animations). They convey hierarchy and state changes to the user.
guide.effects_motion_desc: Duration and easing definitions to maintain consistent animation quality.
guide.effects_motion_guideline: Defines highly responsive motion. Hover and click interactions are ultra-fast (83ms-167ms), while entrances like dialogs feature natural deceleration (250ms-333ms). Prioritize using var(--transition-base) or specific easing tokens.
guide.effects_motion_out_back_desc: Adds emphasis to movements like button hovers by slightly overshooting before settling.
guide.effects_motion_spring_desc: Suitable for natural, elastic movements like opening/closing Accordions or Drawers.
guide.effects_shadow_ambient_desc: Soft, diffused shadow caused by ambient lighting environment. Provides stability and grounding.
guide.effects_shadow_elevation_desc: Sharper shadow caused by a specific light source. Emphasizes the height and separation of elements.
guide.effects_shadow_guideline: Utilizes a multi-layered design combining Ambient and Elevation lights. Choose the level of elevation based on element stacking order (z-index) and importance.
guide.effects_shadow_multi_layer_desc: By combining Ambient and Elevation layers, we achieve a more realistic depth that mimics real-world lighting.
guide.effects_opacity_desc: Opacity tokens for expressing UI states. Always reference these tokens instead of hardcoded values.
guide.effects_opacity_ghost: Ghost UI elements (close buttons, placeholder icons, etc.)
guide.effects_opacity_guideline: Use these three levels — disabled / ghost / secondary — instead of hardcoded values (0.5, 0.6, 0.7).
guide.effects_interaction_bg_desc: When changing background colors in :hover or :active states, use CSS Color Level 4 oklch relative color syntax instead of opacity or filter: brightness(). This produces perceptually uniform lightness changes across both light and dark modes.
guide.effects_interaction_bg_rule_ng: NG — filter: brightness() or opacity alters all colors (bg, text, border) simultaneously and behaves differently in dark mode
guide.effects_interaction_bg_rule_ok: OK — oklch relative color adjusts only the L (lightness) channel, giving visually consistent results in any theme
guide.effects_interaction_bg_opacity_note: opacity may only be used for visibility toggles (opacity: 0 → 1). The disabled state may continue to use opacity tokens (--wim-opacity-disabled etc.).
guide.effects_interaction_bg_multivariant_desc: When the background color varies by variant, store it in a local CSS variable (--bg) and reference it in the hover rule.
guide.effects_interaction_bg_guideline: Use oklch(from var(--token) calc(l * 0.9) c h) for darkening, calc(l * 1.1) for lightening. Store dynamic backgrounds in a --bg local variable.

perf.animation_desc: For components with continuous or complex animations, use the `will-change` CSS property to prompt browser optimization.
perf.animation_micro_interactions_desc: Applied to small operations like switch toggles or accordion expansions to achieve an immediate, tangible feel.
perf.animation_note_desc: Use sparingly as it consumes memory and GPU resources. Avoid applying to many elements simultaneously.
